label: Retro-Deformation Software
description: Software suite used to mathematically reverse the crushing and shearing forces of millions of years of burial.

features.function: If the left side of a jaw is missing, the software mirrors the right side to create a perfect 'restored' whole.
Calculates the original volume of the bone by identifying 'stress vectors' in the digital mesh.

game_mechanics.puzzle_solve: The player must manually pull 'nodes' on the 3D model to align the joints properly, like a digital orthopedic surgeon.
